title: P-256 paired postindex,64-record scanner and fully itemized cold work

claims.statement: For the protected full-production P-256 target, the complete cold paired stored-leaf algorithm of proof.md recovers the scalar with probability at least0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh ideal coins under the stated scalar-instruction machine. At q1=188730254,q2=2^27 and2^72 nodes, its exact ledger is117646947460883105240467468439716649500672 scalar instructions, below2^126.467731493727 target units at C=1000. All preprocessing, failed trials/caps, transport, candidate resolution, verification and output are included. The universal scanner bound is195n/64+26b+8(cap+1)+2; forward139n+11 and backward710n+9 are justified and tested. Generator/header and resolver charges are each2^26 with explicit conservative accounting in COLD_ACCOUNTING.md. Peak memory below2^136 bytes and preprocessing below2^118 units remain justified. This is an analytic bound, not a production-size execution or formal certification. Attribution and all limitations are retained; changed source requires fresh external review before publication.

experiments.purpose: Run independent field and pair checks, full batch inversion, metadata and capacity controls, small complete two-hop routing, actual toy scalar recovery, and exact probability/cold-work/layout consequences. Test scope is distinguished from the production proof.
